narratives.body: Chelsea confirmed a French-born Super Falcons-eligible forward joined on a professional deal. The club also plans a future move for Strasbourg winger Gessime Yassine. Danny Welbeck spoke on leadership and community honouring, while Rachael Adedini's profile was highlighted. Emi Martinez confirmed a new aim after surgery and will miss some games due to injury. Estevao received brutally honest transfer advice despite Xabi Alonso's promise. A player with 23 minutes of playing time was urged to leave. George Weah recalled his historic debut derby win against Tottenham. Simon Jordan claimed Chelsea are 'bigger and worse offenders' than Man City despite 114 guilty verdicts. Penders was given an opportunity after Martinez's injury.
narratives.headline: Chelsea transfers, injuries and disciplinary claims
